shared_elements: bearded male human figure in strict profile
hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls
arm extended forward with hand grasping/held out
surface texture rendered as repeated scale/feather-like units
justification: Both depict bearded men in strict profile with the same distinctive convention of hair and beard as dense rows of tight curls, a fillet on the head, forward-extended grasping arm and richly patterned fringed dress, with textured surfaces built from repeated scale-like units (fleece in A, feathers in B) — a fairly specific shared repertoire of figural conventions. The subjects differ substantially, however: A is a horizontal procession of two men leading a pair of horned rams, while B is a single tall wing-bearing figure holding a staff and small objects, with no animals and a vertical single-figure panel format.
